name: Workshop on the Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models
desc: Treats the linguistic and symbolic medium through which foundation models perceive, reason, and act as a first-class design axis, on par with architecture and scale.

name: DiffuLM: Diffusion Language Models — Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning
desc: The first NeurIPS workshop dedicated to diffusion language models, spanning foundations and theory, efficiency, and reasoning.

name: Beyond Next Token Prediction: Diffusion and Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding
desc: Explores the theory, algorithms, and applications of discrete diffusion and flow models for parallel, non-causal, controllable generation.

name: Real-Time Conversational Agents: Toward Natural Multimodal Interaction
desc: Focuses on real-time conversational agents across voice, video, and language under hard latency budgets, including turn-taking, prosody, and live-system evaluation.

name: AI for Science: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists
desc: Asks how to trust, judge, and act on AI-generated science when verifiers are imperfect, scarce, or absent, and how to allocate scarce verification budgets.

name: AI for Stochastic Dynamics: From Theoretical Foundations to Scientific Applications
desc: Convenes research on learning stochastic dynamics, linking SDEs/SPDEs, diffusion and score-based models, and neural operators with scientific applications.

name: On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints
desc: Treats on-device intelligence as an interdisciplinary problem spanning efficient foundation-model design, adaptation, reliability, and evaluation under resource constraints.

name: Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling
desc: Builds foundation models that forecast, simulate, adapt, and support decisions in systems evolving across time, modalities, and scales.

name: Workshop for Autonomous Machine Learning Research
desc: A discussant-led workshop on ML research conducted end-to-end by autonomous agents, anchoring autonomous research in human judgment and public dialogue.

name: Optimization for Machine Learning
desc: The 18th OPT workshop on optimization for machine learning, this year focusing on "Can Anything Beat Adam? Frontier Optimizers" and next-generation methods.

name: Dynamic Alignment in Human-AI Coupled Systems
desc: Develops theoretical, algorithmic, and evaluative foundations of dynamic bidirectional human-AI alignment as AI shifts to long-term interactive actors.

name: AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
desc: Brings together researchers and clinicians building cancer pathology foundation models that move from technical benchmarks to validated clinical impact.

name: VLM4RWD: Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment
desc: Focuses on principles, methods, and evaluation for grounded, faithful, and reliable vision-language(-action) models deployed in real-world settings.

name: Trustworthy AI Evaluation (TAI-Eval)
desc: Treats AI evaluation itself as an object of study, addressing robustness, causality, measurement validity, and risk in modern AI assessment.

name: PTA: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents
desc: Studies how pretrained representations can be aligned with and transformed into effective behavior for sequential decision-making agents.

name: Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks
desc: Fosters work on benchmarking, evaluating, and deploying robust, trustworthy agentic AI systems for complex, dynamic enterprise operations.

name: Physical Understanding for Decision-Making: Bridging Foundation Models and Reliable Agents
desc: Examines how AI systems can understand the physical world well enough to make safe, reliable decisions, bridging foundation and world models with agents.

name: Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning
desc: Highlights ML applications for climate mitigation, adaptation, and climate science, this year under the theme "Fostering Ground-Up Innovation in AI and Climate".

name: AI4Mat: AI for Accelerated Materials Design
desc: Brings AI researchers and materials scientists together on AI-driven materials discovery, spanning design, synthesis, and characterization, with a focus on scaling laws for materials reasoning and automating real discovery.

name: AI Foundations for Power Grids: From Models to Deployment at Scale
desc: Brings power systems to the ML community as a methodological challenge, centered on how to evaluate learning-based methods under realistic, evolving operating conditions from benchmarks to deployment.

name: World Models in Physical AI
desc: One-day workshop on learned world models of physical-world dynamics for embodied AI, converging generative modeling, reinforcement learning, robotics, computer vision, and autonomous driving.

name: Machine Learning for Systems
desc: Annual interdisciplinary workshop on applying ML (including LLMs and agentic workflows) to design and optimize computer systems, and to improve the infrastructure that trains and serves them.

name: The Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
desc: Third edition workshop on the safety, security, and trustworthiness of AI agents that reason and act in open-ended real-world environments, spanning methods, benchmarks, and frameworks.

name: Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems
desc: Workshop on self-evolving, diversity-driven search methods for building robust and adaptable AI systems.

name: Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB): Human-Centered Interpretation for Understanding Agents, Humans, and Interaction
desc: First workshop on human-centered interpretation of agent behavior, bridging AI with social science and HCI to understand agents, humans, and their interaction.

name: AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap
desc: Addresses the gap between benchmark success and real-world drug discovery, promoting reliable, interpretable, and experimentally actionable AI for therapeutic development.

name: Simulations for Biology and Chemistry (Simbiochem)
desc: Second SIMBIOCHEM workshop fusing molecular simulation, generative models, and agentic AI into physics-aligned systems that accelerate biological and chemical discovery.

name: Responsible Communication of Machine Learning Research in Biomedicine (RCMLR)
desc: Bridges the translation gap between ML researchers and the clinicians, scientists, and policymakers who interpret their findings, focusing on responsible communication of capabilities and limits.

name: Collaborative, Open, and Decentralized Training of Foundation Models (CODEC-FM)
desc: Workshop on scaling foundation-model training across distributed, heterogeneous compute, from inter-datacenter to internet-scale collaborative open model development.

name: Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy
desc: Shifts AI privacy beyond training-time DP-SGD toward inference-time safety, agentic privacy guardrails, and using AI models themselves to enforce privacy.

name: The Third Workshop on GenAI for Health: Agentic Systems, Clinical Trust, and Future Potential
desc: Third edition convening ML researchers and clinicians to advance capable, safe, and equitable generative AI for health, adding a track on ambient, conversational, and embodied care systems.

name: Continual World Models
desc: Workshop on world models that keep learning from observation, memory, feedback, and interaction, defining a research agenda for continual adaptation beyond frozen predictors.

name: AgenticOS: Co-designing Systems and ML Foundations of an OS Layer for Agentic AI
desc: Co-designs the systems and ML foundations of an operating-system layer for agentic AI, covering memory, scheduling, routing, governance, and reproducibility.

name: Neuro-Symbolic Embodied Intelligence
desc: Workshop on embodied neuro-symbolic AI integrating learned perception, reinforcement learning, LLMs, planning, and structured symbolic knowledge for agents acting in physical or simulated environments.

name: Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
desc: Brings together ML and life-science researchers to build, benchmark, and deploy agentic AI systems for biological discovery, from scientific copilots to closed-loop laboratories.

name: XAI4Science: Knowledge Discovery and Trust through Interpretable Foundation Models
desc: Focuses on explainable, interpretable foundation models for weather and climate forecasting, using XAI to build trust and scientific rigor in data-driven prediction.

name: Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training
desc: Examines how pre-training and post-training stages of LLM training interact, what base models must provide for post-training to succeed, and how to predict training-stage outcomes.

name: Interpretability as a Science: Toward Rigorous Foundations for Understanding LLMs
desc: Asks what it would take to ground LLM interpretability as a rigorous empirical science, focusing on measurement, causality, and falsifiability informed by adjacent sciences.

name: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
desc: Treats verification of AI agents as a first-class research problem, spanning robust verifiers, environment-grounded evaluation, and heterogeneous verification signals.

name: I Can't Believe It's Not Better (ICBINB): Failure Modes of AI in Biology
desc: Studies failure modes of AI in biology, from out-of-distribution generalization and domain shift to robustness and trustworthy scientific discovery.

name: Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
desc: Gathers mathematicians, ML researchers, and neuroscientists to study symmetry and geometry in neural representations shared by brains and machines.

name: Third Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance (ATTRIB)
desc: Focuses on attributing model outputs to training data, spanning contributive and corroborative attribution and downstream uses such as provenance, litigation, and auditing.

name: Robot Learning with World Models: Capabilities, Frontiers, and Challenges
desc: Explores using world models to advance physical AI and robot learning, addressing consistency, physical accuracy, and multimodality beyond vision for real-world control.

name: First Workshop on Meta Agents: Managing Agents that Manage Agents
desc: Examines meta-agents that build, optimize, and supervise other agents, covering technical challenges, evaluation, safety, and governance of their responsible use.

name: 8th Robot Learning Workshop: Is Physical AI Truly Going Zero-Shot?
desc: Debates whether physical AI is going zero-shot, examining foundation models, scaling laws, and embodied generalization in robot learning.

name: Foundation Models for the Brain and Body
desc: Focuses on foundation models for neural and physiological biosignals, spanning brain-computer interfacing, health monitoring, and embodied intelligence.

name: Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4FMAgents)
desc: Addresses continual learning for foundation models and embodied agents in dynamic environments, from catastrophic forgetting to agent self-improvement.

name: Africa in AI
desc: Elevates African perspectives in AI for sustainable development, advancing resource-efficient, trustworthy AI across health, education, and energy.

name: LatinX in AI (LXAI)
desc: Official LatinX in AI affinity workshop offering LatinX researchers a venue for talks, posters, panels, and mentoring across machine learning topics.

name: Muslims in ML (MusIML)
desc: Affinity workshop advancing ML research by Muslim scholars and exploring AI's impact on Muslim communities, emphasizing fairness, ethics, and inclusion.

name: RoCo-Spring: The Robust Correspondence Challenge
desc: Competition-track challenge evaluating robust dense correspondence under realistic corruptions across optical flow, stereo matching, and scene flow.

name: Global South in AI (GlobalSouthAI)
desc: Affinity event strengthening AI research for and from the Global South, covering resource-aware AI, low-resource languages, and AI for social impact.

name: Queer in AI and {Dis}Ability in AI
desc: Joint affinity workshop gathering queer and disabled scholars to explore AI and ML at the intersection of queerness and disability, from research to community building.

name: Women in Machine Learning (WiML)
desc: 21st Women in Machine Learning workshop providing women and non-binary researchers a venue for talks, posters, and mentoring across ML topics.

name: Foundations of Language Model Security: Theory, Practice, and Fundamental Limits
desc: Advances secure-by-design LLM systems, moving beyond attack-defense cycles to formalize LLM security, design reproducible evaluations, and understand fundamental security-utility limits.

name: Reinforcement Learning for Experimental Sciences
desc: Explores reinforcement learning for adaptive experimentation and scientific discovery, focusing on bridging the simulation-to-reality gap in laboratory and field experiments.

name: RoboPAD: Post-Training Adaptation of Robot Foundation Models
desc: Focuses on post-training adaptation of robot foundation models, covering how to adapt, correct, evaluate, and safely improve them after pretraining for real-world deployment.

name: TS-LIMITS: Generalization for Time Series in Tight Settings
desc: Addresses generalization for time series under tight constraints of latency, inference, memory, privacy, and sustainability for practical deployment.

name: Privacy in the Era of Large Opaque Models: Theoretical, Legal, and Practical Perspectives
desc: Examines memorization and privacy risks in opaque foundation models and agentic systems, bridging theoretical, legal, and practical perspectives on defining, measuring, and governing privacy.

name: Real-Time Multimodal Conversational AI
desc: Advances real-time multimodal conversational AI spanning speech, video, and embodied interaction, integrating egocentric, exocentric, and dyadic perspectives.

name: Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models
desc: Focuses on leveraging imperfect, misspecified scientific simulators, using machine learning to account for and mitigate simulator limitations across scientific domains.

name: Bridging Optimal Transport, Learning, and Structured Data: Toward Geometric Distributional Learning
desc: Bridges optimal transport, geometric deep learning, and structured data to build models that jointly capture the geometry and distributional nature of data.

name: Representations for the Physical Sciences
desc: A forum for representation learning in physical systems, centered on self-supervision, transfer learning, sampling, and tokenization of scientific data.

name: Foundations of LLM Post-Training in Changing Environments
desc: Develops principled foundations for LLM post-training under task evolution and distribution shift, addressing repeated adaptation in non-stationary environments.

name: ML4Molecules: Agentic Systems for Molecular Sciences
desc: Focuses on agentic systems for the molecular sciences, from in-silico chemists and closed-loop labs to rigorous benchmarking, negative results, and careful baselines.

name: LIGHT: Deployable Small Foundation Models
desc: Promotes compact, trustworthy, energy-efficient foundation models for real-world deployment through distillation, compression, quantization, and pruning.

name: E-values: From Statistics to ML
desc: Bridges statistics and machine learning around e-values for anytime-valid inference, sequential monitoring, and uncertainty quantification in modern ML systems.

name: PALM: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems
desc: Workshop on safe, personalized, long-term memory for AI agents and conversational assistants, covering memory architectures, personalization, evaluation, and safety.

name: Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4GOOD)
desc: Bridges trustworthy AI, AI for social good, and policy/governance to translate model safety into societal impact, with a multi-agent security and safety track.

name: AIDaR: AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery
desc: Focuses on AI data readiness for scientific discovery, addressing how scientific data should be organized for models and agents and how evaluations determine model reliability.

name: Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM)
desc: Second workshop on the principles of generative modeling, articulating theoretical foundations for expressivity, generalization, inference-time computation, and post-training.

name: Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
desc: Treats neural network artifacts (weights, gradients, representations, training traces) as a data modality, covering model analysis, synthesis, search, and AI supply chains.

name: AI for Meta-Science: Scaling and Organizing Science in the Age of AI Scientists
desc: Treats the scientific enterprise itself as an object of study, focusing on evaluation, verification, peer review, and governance as AI scientists scale research production.

name: AI for Chip Design
desc: Brings together ML and semiconductor communities on AI-driven chip design, covering electronic design automation, physical design, and LLMs for hardware description languages.

name: Machine Learning for Spatially Resolved High-dimensional Biology
desc: Explores ML methods for spatially resolved high-dimensional biology, including spatial multiomics integration, geometry-based learning, and foundation models for tissue data.

name: Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory
desc: Investigates foundations of emergent behavior in systems of LLM-based agents, drawing on control theory, game theory, and social sciences to understand system-level risks.

name: AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning
desc: Develops predictive theoretical principles for efficient deep learning, connecting scaling laws and learning dynamics with pruning, quantization, and sparse computation.

name: SLM-Agents: 1st Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems
desc: Focuses on small language models as the foundation for agentic AI systems, covering compression, distillation, hardware co-design, and on-device deployment.

name: Grounded User Simulation for Model Evaluation and Training
desc: Works to establish evidence, standards, and open tools for trustworthy user simulation in AI evaluation and training, centered on diversity, fidelity, and validity.

name: AI and the Self: Human Identity, Authenticity, and Agency in the Age of AI
desc: Explores how AI systems mediate human identity, agency, authenticity, and flourishing, combining technical, empirical, and philosophical methods.

name: Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML)
desc: Studies how learning systems recognize, represent, and act under the limits of their knowledge, spanning epistemic uncertainty, robustness, and uncertainty quantification.

name: New in Machine Learning (NewInML)
desc: Supports researchers who have not yet published at a top ML venue, offering mentoring, reviewing, and guidance to help them publish and contribute to ML research.

name: The 1st Workshop on Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
desc: Examines how AI systems can perceive, represent, and reason about the physical world through geometry, physical characteristics, and multimodal sensing.

name: AI for Verifiable Coding (VERICODEGEN)
desc: Advances AI for verifiable coding, where agents collaborate with proof assistants, solvers, and static analyzers to co-design code and proofs with machine-checkable guarantees.

name: The Sixth Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI)
desc: Focuses on mathematical reasoning and agentic AI, spanning theorem proving, autoformalization, conjecture generation, and human-AI collaboration in mathematics.

name: DynaFront: Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games
desc: Highlights the unifying role of dynamical systems in optimization, sampling, and game theory, with applications to diffusion models and adversarial training.

name: World Models for High-Stakes Health: Reliable Clinical Trial Simulation and Intervention-Aware Reasoning
desc: Advances patient world models for reliable clinical trial simulation and intervention-aware reasoning in high-stakes healthcare.

name: Interpretability for Discovery: Understanding and Discovering Novel Knowledge in AI Models
desc: Reframes interpretability as a tool for scientific discovery, extracting novel, testable knowledge from learned model representations across scientific domains.

name: Medical Reasoning with Vision Language Foundation Models
desc: Explores reasoning capabilities in medical vision-language foundation models, including chain-of-thought diagnosis and multimodal grounding for clinical decisions.

name: First Workshop on Reliable Evaluation for Language Models (JUDGe)
desc: Investigates the reliability and validity of LLM-based evaluators, treating evaluator failure as a systems problem across bias, calibration, and safety.

name: Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents (IAEval)
desc: Focuses on rigorous, scalable, and scientific methods for evaluating interactive agents, from rubric-based grading to LLM user simulators, across multi-turn and tool-using systems.

name: SaTQuML: Secure and Trustworthy Quantum Machine Learning
desc: Bridges quantum machine learning, cybersecurity, and trustworthy AI, emphasizing rigorous evaluation of secure QML systems and QML methods for cyberdefense applications.

name: EconML: Economics for Machine Learning
desc: Brings together ML, economics, and game theory to map economic consequences of ML, using economic tools for learning and alignment, and studying ecosystems of interacting models.

name: Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents (TTCL)
desc: Studies AI agents that continually acquire, consolidate, and refine knowledge during deployment, uniting test-time, continual, and agentic learning without catastrophic forgetting.

name: AI-Native Academia: Authorship, Peer Review, and Conference Governance under AI
desc: Examines how institutions of science should change when AI is embedded in authorship, peer review, citation, and governance, building a shared taxonomy and security framework.

name: Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA)
desc: Brings together researchers and practitioners on continual learning for enterprise AI agents, covering adaptation, orchestration, memory, benchmarks, and real-world deployment challenges.

name: AI Agents for Biomedical Imaging and Multimodal Clinical Data
desc: Focuses on AI agents for biomedical imaging and multimodal clinical data, exploring tool orchestration, grounding, multi-step reasoning, and evaluation in clinical workflows.

name: The BabyVLM Workshop: Toward Developmentally Plausible Multimodal Systems
desc: Asks how to build multimodal models that learn as efficiently as human infants, using developmentally plausible pretraining and human-inspired evaluation in vision-language systems.

name: The Agentic Web: Networked, Continually-Adapting Agent Ecosystems
desc: Treats the networked agent collective as a research object, studying representation, learning, coordination, and safety for continually adapting agent ecosystems at internet scale.

name: Second Workshop on Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation
desc: Advances principled research on LLM-based social agents, covering social reasoning, simulation validity, pluralistic alignment, and evaluation beyond task accuracy.

name: Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI
desc: Explores how to design AI agents that reason about and adapt to compute, energy, memory, latency, and cost budgets, enabling efficient and accessible deployment.

name: Workshop on Child Safety in AI
desc: Addresses technical and sociotechnical challenges of protecting children from AI risks, spanning safe data, robust models, deployment safeguards, and policy.

name: Human-AI Coevolution: Measuring Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era
desc: Builds methodological foundations for empirically evaluating human-agent teams, focusing on validity, expert disagreement, and adaptive evaluation as systems and users coevolve.

name: Second Workshop on ML×OR (MLxOR)
desc: Presents developments at the intersection of machine learning and operations research, emphasizing decision-making with GenAI and OR for uncertainty-aware applications.

name: GEM: Integrating Generative and Experimental Platforms for Biomolecular Design
desc: Bridges generative machine learning and experimental biology for biomolecular design, with in-silico and wet-lab tracks and seed grants for dry-wet collaborations.

name: DevAI: Developmental Perspectives on AI
desc: Brings together AI, cognitive science, neuroscience, and developmental psychology to explore what human development teaches about building more robust, human-like AI.

name: AI & Science: Evolution or Extinction?
desc: Develops a domain-specific safety, alignment, and evaluation agenda for AI in science, examining epistemic integrity when AI systems participate in scientific discovery.
